options.name: api_token
options.description: FlashArray API token for admin privileged user.

options.name: base_dn
options.description: Sets the base of the Distinguished Name (DN) of the directory service groups. The base should consist of only Domain Components (DCs). The base_dn will populate with a default value when a URI is entered by parsing domain components from the URI. The base DN should specify DC= for each domain component and multiple DCs should be separated by commas.

options.name: bind_password
options.description: Sets the password of the bind_user user name account.

options.name: bind_user
options.description: Sets the user name that can be used to bind to and query the directory. For Active Directory, enter the username - often referred to as sAMAccountName or User Logon Name - of the account that is used to perform directory lookups. For OpenLDAP, enter the full DN of the user.

options.name: certificate
options.description: The certificate of the Certificate Authority (CA) that signed the certificates of the directory servers, which is used to validate the authenticity of the configured servers A valid signed certificate in PEM format (Base64 encoded) Includes the "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----" and "-----END CERTIFICATE-----" lines

options.name: check_peer
options.description: Whether or not server authenticity is enforced when a certificate is provided

options.name: client_id
options.description: ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: context
options.description: Name of fleet member on which to perform the operation. This requires the array receiving the request is a member of a fleet and the context name to be a member of the same fleet.

options.name: disable_warnings
options.description: Disable insecure certificate warnings in debug logs

options.name: dstype
options.description: The type of directory service to work on

options.name: enable
options.description: Whether to enable or disable directory service support.

options.name: fa_url
options.description: FlashArray management IPv4 address or Hostname.

options.name: force_bind_password
options.description: Will force the bind password to be reset even if the bind user password is unchanged. If set to I(false) and I(bind_user) is unchanged the password will not be reset.

options.name: id_token
options.description: A pre-signed JWT to authenticate with, as an alternative to I(api_token). The token is exchanged by the array for a short-lived access token. Requires a matching API Client to be registered on the array (see M(everpure.flasharray.purefa_apiclient)).

options.name: issuer
options.description: The API Client's trusted identity issuer registered on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: key_id
options.description: Key ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: private_key_file
options.description: Path to the PEM RSA private key used to sign an identity token, as an alternative to I(api_token). Requires I(client_id), I(key_id), I(issuer) and I(username).

options.name: private_key_password
options.description: Password protecting I(private_key_file), if encrypted.

options.name: state
options.description: Create, delete or test directory service configuration

options.name: uri
options.description: A list of up to 30 URIs of the directory servers. Each URI must include the scheme ldap:// or ldaps:// (for LDAP over SSL), a hostname, and a domain name or IP address. For example, ldap://ad.company.com configures the directory service with the hostname "ad" in the domain "company.com" while specifying the unencrypted LDAP protocol.

options.name: user_login
options.description: User login attribute in the structure of the configured LDAP servers. Typically the attribute field that holds the users unique login name. Default value is I(sAMAccountName) for Active Directory or I(uid) for all other directory services

options.name: user_object
options.description: Value of the object class for a management LDAP user. Defaults to I(User) for Active Directory servers, I(posixAccount) or I(shadowAccount) for OpenLDAP servers dependent on the group type of the server, or person for all other directory servers.

options.name: username
options.description: Username the issued token should be granted to. Must be a valid user on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).
